subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub accept this publisher-follow API as the base contract for the follow controls and notification stack before the dependent slices land?
rationale: The PR adds a new API-token surface over private user preference state and is the base of stacked follow/discovery/notification PRs, so implementation review alone cannot decide the product boundary.

options.title: Accept after proof and contract cleanup
options.body: Require real API proof plus docs/OpenAPI/sourcemap cleanup, then review this base API as the follow stack foundation.

options.title: Pause for stack-level review
options.body: Hold this base slice until the controls, discovery, and notification PRs can be reviewed as one product boundary.

options.title: Decline the API direction
options.body: Close or redirect the branch if maintainers do not want publisher follows exposed as an API-token feature now.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and contract cleanup
recommendation.body: Require real API proof plus docs/OpenAPI/sourcemap cleanup, then review this base API as the follow stack foundation.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest history match for the API route/schema package surface that this decision would stabilize.
